winner.title: Passenger Seat Traffic Control
winner.public_hook: He didn't marry a quiet passenger. He married mission control.
winner.universal_truth: Some relationships are not one calm driver and one silent passenger; they are one steering wheel and two opinions.
winner.emotional_obstacle: Her passenger-seat commentary can look like nagging or control unless the story proves it is their shared road-trip language.
aachu_nancho_proof: Maps says left in 300 meters; she says LEFT-LEFT-LEFT now.
Her foot finds the invisible brake.
winner.zuv_himanshu_role: He makes her the co-pilot, not the problem: he keeps driving safely, stays amused, asks 'Captain, next?', and turns the commentary into their shared system.
winner.payoff: Maybe love is one steering wheel and two opinions.
slide_copy_candidate: He didn't marry a quiet passenger. He married mission control.

why_it_beats_fake_time: The contradiction is harder: quiet passenger versus mission control.
The middle has multiple behavior receipts instead of one earring/timing beat.
The invisible brake is a physical comic proof beat that can be drawn instantly.
Comment behavior is clearer: viewers can tag the passenger-seat supervisor or driver.
The visual plan can stay behavior-first instead of becoming polished soft romance.
required_repairs_before_packaging: Do not frame her as a nagging or controlling wife.
Do not show unsafe driving, touching the steering wheel, panic, anger, or actual danger.
Show Himanshu/Zuv actively choosing the shared bit: amused, safe, asking for instructions, treating her as co-pilot.
Vary visuals within the car: dashboard, passenger foot/invisible brake, AC controls, playlist, road sign, driver reaction.
Avoid readable real map UI, plate numbers, route data, or private car details.
Repair the final line if needed to make it more tender without losing tag behavior.

runner_ups.title: She Cross-Examines The Whole Market
runner_ups.why_not_winner: Very strong desi receipts and visual variety, but more shopping-cliche risk and slightly less instant comment behavior than passenger-seat supervision.

runner_ups.title: She Starts A Search Party
runner_ups.why_not_winner: Strong universal hook, but higher risk of making her look silly unless handled with great affection.

selector_verdict: GO_WITH_SAFETY_REPAIR: Passenger Seat Traffic Control is the strongest corrected next idea because it is not merely tender or pretty. It starts with a public contradiction, escalates through concrete behavior receipts, gives one physically funny proof beat, and creates obvious partner-tag behavior. It must be repaired visually and tonally so the joke reads as shared co-pilot language, not nagging.
